name: make-it-a-bit-better
description: An autonomous product-polish loop: every round opens a mandatory fresh brainstorm (3 perspective subagents), picks one small angle, implements, verifies and commits it, and logs it in a per-project ledger; oversized ideas go to an icebox. A bit better, round after round.

interface.shortDescription: One small verified improvement per round
interface.longDescription: Runs an autonomous product-polish loop: every round opens a mandatory brainstorm from three forced perspectives, picks one small angle capped at three files or about a hundred lines, implements and verifies it, commits it, and logs the round in a per-project ledger that a bundled checker validates. Good ideas too big for one round wait in an icebox; a red check is reverted rather than shipped.
